authority: Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI), Government of India

description.en: New Aadhaar enrollment for Indian residents who have not been assigned an Aadhaar number. Aadhaar is a 12-digit unique identification number issued by UIDAI based on biometric and demographic data.

verifiedConditions.claim: Any resident of India, irrespective of age and gender, can voluntarily enroll for Aadhaar. A resident is defined as a person who has resided in India for 182 days or more in the 12 months preceding the date of application.
Only one Aadhaar number is generated for a person. Duplicate Aadhaar is not issued.

unverifiedEligibility: NRIs can apply after residing in India for 182 days; specific documentation for NRI applicants is not fully detailed here.
Newborns can be enrolled based on the Aadhaar of parents; the child enrollment process has additional requirements.

requirements.claim: Proof of Identity (POI) is required. Any one of the following is accepted: passport, PAN card, ration card, voter ID, driving license, government photo ID card, NREGS job card, photo ID issued by a recognized educational institution, or bank passbook with photo.

Proof of Address (POA) is required. Accepted documents include passport, bank statement/passbook, post office account statement, ration card, voter ID, driving license, government photo ID card, electricity bill (not older than 3 months), water bill (not older than 3 months), telephone landline bill (not older than 3 months), property tax receipt (not older than 1 year), or credit card statement (not older than 3 months).

Proof of Date of Birth is required for verified DOB on Aadhaar. Accepted: birth certificate, SSLC book/certificate, passport, government-issued photo ID with DOB, or PAN card. If DOB proof is not provided, age can be declared and marked as 'Declared' or 'Approximate' on Aadhaar.
Biometric data capture (fingerprints of all 10 fingers, iris scan of both eyes, and facial photograph) is mandatory at the enrollment centre.
The Aadhaar enrollment form must be filled with demographic information (name, DOB, gender, address, mobile number, email). The form can be pre-filled online or completed at the enrollment centre.

processInformation.claim: The enrollment process: (1) Book an appointment online at appointments.uidai.gov.in or visit an Aadhaar enrollment centre, (2) Carry original documents for POI, POA, and DOB proof, (3) Fill enrollment form, (4) Biometric capture (fingerprints, iris, photo), (5) Receive an acknowledgement slip with 14-digit Enrollment ID (EID), (6) Aadhaar number generated and dispatched via India Post.
doesNotEstablish: This record does not guarantee availability of appointments at specific centres.
Walking in without an appointment may not be possible at all centres.

processInformation.claim: Enrollment status can be checked online using the 14-digit EID on the myAadhaar portal. e-Aadhaar can be downloaded from the UIDAI website once the Aadhaar number is generated.

output.claim: An Aadhaar letter containing the 12-digit Aadhaar number is dispatched via India Post. e-Aadhaar (digital copy) can be downloaded from the UIDAI website.

fees.claim: Aadhaar enrollment is free of charge. No fee is to be charged for new enrollment.

fees.applicability: Aadhaar data update (biometric or demographic) at enrollment centre
fees.claim: For updates to Aadhaar data at an enrollment centre, a fee of Rs. 50 (including GST) is applicable.

processingTime.claim: UIDAI states that the Aadhaar number is usually generated within 90 days of enrollment. e-Aadhaar may be available earlier for download.
processingTime.estimatedCompletionDatePolicy: 90 days from enrollment date as upper bound. Many enrollments are processed within 2-3 weeks.
processingTime.fallbackThresholdMentionedBySource: If not generated within 90 days, applicant should contact the regional UIDAI office

limitations: This record covers new enrollment for adults. Child enrollment, NRI enrollment, and update/correction workflows are separate.
The accepted document list is summarized; always verify against the current UIDAI valid documents page.
Enrollment centre availability and walk-in policies vary by location.
This record does not cover Aadhaar-based authentication or KYC services.
Biometric exceptions (persons with disabilities) have separate processes not covered here.
